acquisition: Every original generated outbound route in both physical layouts from the common initial sensor state
policy: No manual target insertion, no closed-loop selection, no weight or route changes; preserve route failures
reference: Independent actual source triangles sampled deterministically:100000 global and10000 per object; seeds20261120,20261121,20261122. Fixed original0.8m reachable camera lattice plus start/four headings,1mm first-hit visibility; same reference helper as earlier experiments
surface_metrics: Per object and global correct surface net increment, newly recovered area, regression area; source sample area weights. Completeness measured against native TSDF triangle distance, not predicted templates
aggregation: All candidate outcomes and all2layouts×3cues×2temperatures retained; compare selected G/S actual area/cost. Cue and temperature rows share branch outcomes and are not independent trials
claim_boundary: Controlled mechanism branch study only, not full unknown exploration, physical robotics or natural semantic detection
render_limit: Cross-layout depth differs by at most5e-7m due float32 triangle intersection. No raw data editing. Within each layout all cues and temperatures use exactly the same acquired bank
